text: Displaying the progress pride flag between two American flags during a White House pride event was “in breach of US Flag Code.”

text: While it cannot be seen in this photo, the American flag is being flown on top of the White House in the center of the building, and therefore, the flag code is not being violated. text: The flag atop the White House is a permanent flag pole display.   The 3 flags are a temporary separate display from a “bannister”. This is not a flat wall display, therefore the US flag should be placed in the most prominent position, front center. Not just 1 code section in play.
